sweep_recipe.notes:
WALKING-ONLY CHANNEL WEIGHTS. Identical to go2_mix36_base except loss.channel_weight_datasets lists the walking corpus alone rather than both.

WHY. equal_domain_combined_std sets w_i = walk_std_i^2 / mean_d(std_d,i^2), so listing the excitation corpus shifts the weights even in a cell that sees ZERO excitation rows. Measured: median weight 0.659, and by gate family body_rate 0.195, gravity 0.225, body_vel 0.770, with roll_rate_radps at 0.0408 -- 24x down. joint_pos at 1.178 is the only group weighted up. The families the gate reads are the ones most shifted.

TWO THINGS THIS FIXES. The sweep's zero-excitation control is currently 'walking data with excitation-informed weights', not 'walking data alone', so the curve has no clean intercept. And the contact-channel ablation reported as 0.518 -> 1.190 compared a 40-channel model weighted from ONE corpus against a 36-channel model weighted from TWO -- a second difference, so '2.3x' is not established at that strength. This run isolates the weighting, leaving the channel set as the only difference.
